name: Duke
overview: The title 'Duke' in Scripture refers to the princes or leaders among specific ancient peoples, notably the descendants of Esau in Edom and the Midianites. Genesis 36 details these dukes as prominent sons of Esau's lineage, identifying them as rulers within the land of Edom, such as Teman, Omar, and Korah. These verses emphasize the structured leadership within Esau's family and highlight the established governance among the Edomites, underscoring God's providential ordering of nations and peoples.
